description: How does Medicare’s allowed amount for one code vary across the US? Physician Fee Schedule amounts in all 109 Medicare localities (or one state’s) with the national amount and range, computed by Distill from CMS’s RVU and GPCI files. The facility and non-facility allowed amounts (non-QP) for one code in each of the 109 Medicare payment localities, or those of one state, with the national amount (all GPCIs 1.0) and the range: how much the same service is allowed for across the country. From CMS’s relative value files for the release in force on the date. Updated quarterly. Price: $0.02 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Freshness only (the amounts and change records are computed from the CMS files deterministically): 1 until the first day of the calendar quarter after the files were last checked, then halving every 30 days. Medicare Physician Fee Schedule amounts computed from CMS’s published RVU, GPCI and conversion-factor files: what Original Medicare allows a participating clinician (before deductible and coinsurance), not what another payer pays; not a quote, not medical, billing or coding advice. See /terms. CPT® codes are served as codes only: their descriptors are AMA copyright and are never included (nor dental CDT descriptors). CPT is a registered trademark of the American Medical Association. HCPCS Level II descriptions are CMS’s.

code.description: The HCPCS Level II or CPT code, e.g. 99213, 70551 or G0439.

date.description: The date of service, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, UTC): picks the release in force.

modifier.description: Optional modifier with its own RVUs: 26 (professional component), TC (technical component) or 53. Omit for the global service.

release.description: A quarterly release instead of a date, e.g. 2026D (A from 1 Jan, B Apr, C Jul, D Oct).
